summary: ora-1 quantified 27 antihypertensive l4_clinical values but delivered them only in the ephemeral session buffer; payload lost when the lane closed. Required full regeneration via ora-5.
root_cause: Oracle lane is read-only (read_files only) and cannot persist JSON to disk. The orchestrator (me) relied on the lane's ephemeral response buffer without requiring a file write or capturing the full payload before lane close. Board result shows only a summary ('JSON output above is ready for the orchestrator to strip...') with the payload not included in the returned task result.
recovery: Regenerated in fresh lane ora-5 with explicit instruction to persist JSON to %TEMP%\opencode\l4_antihypertensive.json; payload persisted and merged into api\drugs.json. Net effect on deliverable: none (regenerated values used).
lesson: Read-only specialist lanes must write deliverables to disk themselves (via a permitted path) or the orchestrator must capture the payload inside the task result before lane close. Never assume a long JSON payload survives in an ephemeral buffer.
